python3 kb/tools/selftest_v21.py passes 60/60 including S16 to S18 and R16. The N-series window edges behave as pinned: 300 s exactly is not met (more_than), 301 s is met, and an app timer or policy-object reading that flips the result gives SOURCE_CONFLICT with tier HUMAN.

Wait window edges: scheduled_time in UTC 'Z' form, driver arriving late (arrival 08:55, cancel 09:00:30 gives WAIVE, 09:01:00 gives UPHOLD) or early, cancelling before the scheduled time (elapsed clamped to 0), no scheduled_time (anchor is the arrival, RECORDS_MISSING, tier APPROVE). notice_valid, rider_notified values: True, False, 'true', 'TRUE', 'True ', 'yes', '1', 1 count as yes; False, 'false ', 'no', '0', 0 count as no; 'y', 'n', 't', 'f', 'none', 'null', '', blanks, 'notified', 'delivered', 'sent', 'failed', 'pending', 'partial', 'true (failed)', 1.0, '1.0', 'on', 'read', 'seen' all return None and the case goes to HUMAN. A negative excess fare can no longer be refunded.

Section 6 ruling path in the route and surge engines: fee or fare difference over S$50 gives HUMAN (surge diff 63.00 tested); deviation 2.0 km is AUTO, 2.01 km is APPROVE; 1.0 km exactly is UPHOLD and 1.01 km is a partial refund; a fraud flag on rider or driver is counted by fraud_flag_count including string, missing and unreadable values (unreadable counts as a flag).

Surge engine: an unchanged or fallen surge gives UPHOLD (FC-R-SURGE-NOT-HIGHER); a fare above the quote with no surge increase, a booking fee change, a surge activated after the trip start, a missing record and a safety complaint all give HUMAN; the full differential is refunded only when it is solely the surge.

Safety content (Section 5.2) under organizer_v2_1 returns HUMAN with no outcome even when combined with a void or an unreadable contact record (K18, S21). RydeTAXI beats the void (policy gap, HUMAN). A rider message placing the rider at the pick-up gives R7 HUMAN. Injection text is flagged and ignored.

findings.evidence: tokens = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", method)); if not tokens & {"app", "push", "inapp"}: ... else return True. findings.evidence: Lines 54 and 56: 'if tokens & {"sms", "email", ...}: return False' and 'if not tokens & {"app", "push", "inapp", "notification"}: return False'. rider_notified=True, ts 21:04:50 before start: 'in-app, sms' -> valid=False FULL_REFUND 4.5 AUTO; 'app and email' -> False FULL_REFUND AUTO; 'push + sms' -> False; 'in-application' -> False FULL_REFUND 4.5 AUTO; 'application' -> False; 'popup', 'banner', 'toast', 'alert', 'modal', 'dialog', 'inbox', 'fcm', 'apns', 'firebase', 'mobile', 'lock screen', 'in ride card', 'interstitial' -> False FULL_REFUND 4.5 AUTO; method '  ' (spaces) -> False FULL_REFUND AUTO while method '' -> None HUMAN; method True or 5 or {'a':1} -> False FULL_REFUND AUTO.

findings.suggested_fix: Only return False when a deny-listed channel is the only channel found (no in-app token at all). If an in-app token and a deny-listed token are both present, return None. findings.claim: The notification time is compared only with the trip start, never with when the surge was activated, so a notification stamped before the surge existed (a day earlier, or before the quote) is accepted as the Section 3.2 notice and the surge fare is upheld at AUTO.

findings.claim: Under organizer_v2_1 'no contact' now voids the fee at tier AUTO (CONTACT_NOT_ATTEMPTED was dropped as an approval trigger), but the contact count reads only chat_logs with sender exactly 'driver' and type exactly 'call' or 'message', from the assignment event. An absent chat_logs key, a driver call that only the app_events record, a differently spelled sender, or a missing assignment event is therefore read as proof of no contact and the fee is voided automatically.
findings.evidence: calls = [c for c in chat if c["sender"] == "driver" and c["type"] == "call" and c_from <= T(c["timestamp"]) <= end]; the v21 trigger filter 'not (v21 and f == "CONTACT_NOT_ATTEMPTED")'. Round 1 recorded the exact-spelling matching as D56 item 4, but before A6 it only lowered the tier; with the void it now changes the money automatically.
findings.suggested_fix: Count a driver call also from app_events driver_called_rider and accept normalized sender and type (kb.resolve TX-ROLE, strip, lower). When the app events and chat_logs disagree about driver contact, or chat_logs is absent, or the assignment event is missing, do not void at AUTO: flag RECORDS_MISSING (or SOURCE_CONFLICT) so the tier is APPROVE or HUMAN.

findings.claim: For a no-show, a Section 6.1 'above S$50: always human review, AI prepares the case file only' result is turned into tier APPROVE, not HUMAN.
